scope: 33 bow and 9 crossbow released registrations. Configured component inputs and class-method evidence, not measured combat outcomes.
limits: Speed is a modifier, not seconds
Crossbow reload path divides 1.25 by modifier, applies enchantment charging-time hook, multiplies by 20 then floors
Bow release multiplies elapsed use ticks by draw modifier before the arrow-loose hook and inherited power calculation
Arrow ammunition eligibility is delegated to living-entity projectile lookup; this does not certify every special-arrow or infinity interaction
Damage input is not guaranteed health loss; projectile and critical modifiers still apply
